scripts.blank: docker compose -p resanorp-blank --project-directory . -f docker/docker-compose.base.yml -f docker/docker-compose.blank.yml --env-file ./envs/.env.blank --profile blank up -V
scripts.build:start: bun run build && bun run start
scripts.dev: bun run dev:up && bun run dev:server
scripts.dev:fresh: docker compose -p resanorp-development --project-directory . -f docker/docker-compose.base.yml -f docker/docker-compose.development.yml --env-file ./envs/.env.development --profile development down -v && bun run dev:up && bun run dev:seed && bun run dev:server
scripts.dev:server: docker compose -p resanorp-development --project-directory . -f docker/docker-compose.base.yml -f docker/docker-compose.development.yml --env-file ./envs/.env.development --profile development up -d --wait && bun run copy-pdf-worker &&bun --env-file=./envs/.env.development ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js dev
scripts.dev:stop: docker compose -p resanorp-development --project-directory . -f docker/docker-compose.base.yml -f docker/docker-compose.development.yml --env-file ./envs/.env.development --profile development down
scripts.dev:up: docker compose -p resanorp-development --project-directory . -f docker/docker-compose.base.yml -f docker/docker-compose.development.yml --env-file ./envs/.env.development --profile development up -d --wait && bun run trust-cert -- -CertPath ./envs/development/caddy/caddy/pki/authorities/local/root.crt
scripts.prisma: docker compose -p resanorp-prisma --project-directory . -f docker/docker-compose.base.yml -f docker/docker-compose.prisma.yml --env-file ./envs/.env.prisma --profile prisma up --force-recreate -V --watch
scripts.reset-env:prisma: docker compose -p resanorp-prisma --project-directory . -f docker/docker-compose.base.yml -f docker/docker-compose.prisma.yml --env-file ./envs/.env.prisma --profile prisma exec app-prisma bun ./src/scripts/run-reset-env.ts
scripts.start: docker compose -p resanorp-production --project-directory . -f docker/docker-compose.base.yml -f docker/docker-compose.production.yml --env-file ./envs/.env.production --profile production up -V
scripts.test:restart: bun run test:stop && bun run test:start
scripts.test:serve: bun run test:up && docker compose -p resanorp-test --project-directory . -f docker/docker-compose.base.yml -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --env-file ./envs/.env.test --profile test logs -f app-test
scripts.test:start: bun run build && docker compose -p resanorp-test --project-directory . -f docker/docker-compose.base.yml -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --env-file ./envs/.env.test --profile test up --force-recreate -d
scripts.test:stop: docker compose -p resanorp-test --project-directory . -f docker/docker-compose.base.yml -f docker/docker-compose.test.yml --env-file ./envs/.env.test --profile test down
